0022600036.text: The Cavaliers (6-6, 2-4 on the road) are 6th in the East and 2 games back in second place in the Central, and they come in on a one-game winning streak after a 5-5 stretch over their last ten. The Heat (5-6, 1-3 at home) are 8th in the East and 1.5 games back in second place in the Southeast, riding a two-game winning streak with a 5-5 record over their last ten, and Giannis Antetokounmpo (wrist), Klay Thompson (ankle) and Pelle Larsson (illness) are all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have no games yet this season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Cavaliers won the last meeting 149-128 in Cleveland on March 27, 2026, while Cleveland's Sam Merrill is out with an elbow injury.
